relatedSnapshot.title: Audit Name 100's account for missing inboxes and credits
relatedSnapshot.description:
#### Workspace Name

Name 7

#### Request Type

Refund

#### Reason for request

Hey team, I've got Name 100 on a call just now and there's a serious billing/technical issue that needs urgent attention before this turns into a refund request.
**The situation:** Name 100 has paid for 33 domains across multiple invoices (totaling $420 per invoice, 10 domains per invoice = 30 inboxes per invoice). He's got receipts showing he paid for 99 inboxes total. The platform is only showing 72 inboxes active on his account. Additionally, he purchased 200k credits, but the system now shows a much lower amount — he says it used to say 210,000 and now it's dropped. Some of those credits appear to have disappeared after a previous backend support interaction where someone said they'd "fix it on the back end."
**What's blocking him right now:** He can't create new email campaigns because his leads capacity is maxed at 61k out of the 200k he bought. The system won't let him upload more or add campaigns without deleting leads from old ones first. This is a legitimate product limitation, but it's compounded by the fact that his billing doesn't match what's actually provisioned.
**What we need:** Pull Name 100's account audit trail and figure out where the 27 missing inboxes went (99 paid for vs. 72 showing). Also track down what happened to his credits — if they were adjusted or removed in a previous backend fix, we need to know why and restore them. Once you've got clarity, let me know if this is a data sync issue, a provisioning bug, or if something got accidentally deleted.
Name 100's got another payment coming up with us and he's frustrated because he's been bounced between multiple team members (Name 8, Name 9, Name 10, Name 101, Name 11, Name 12) who all said they'd fix things on the back end, and nothing has stuck. He's also frustrated because he was sold on podcast booking and other methods during sales that aren't actually available in the platform yet. He's not asked for a refund yet, but he's close. He's asking for either a credit, payment deferral, or some form of compensation while we sort this out. He's been a good customer and has invested heavily (multiple domain purchases, 200k credits), so this is worth saving. Can you review his contract and what was promised vs. what's actually provisioned, and give me a recommendation on what we can offer him?
I'm going to message Name 100 on Slack that this is now our top priority, but I need you to move quickly. Once the audit is done, we can determine what's fair compensation-wise. Let me know what you find.

relatedSnapshot.title: Website-builder (v0) metered usage drives shared credits wallet negative, blocking campaign lead imports
relatedSnapshot.description:
BUG: Yes

EVIDENCE:

* Name 24's Workspace (org <uuid>), billing account <uuid>, provider autumn.
* billing_account.credit_balance = -8937 (lifetime_purchased 0, lifetime_granted 0, lifetime_used 8937). The ledger is negative and never offset by a purchase or grant.
* credit_transaction: 73 rows, all reference_type 'v0_usage' ("v0 website generation usage"), sum -8937, dated 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-14.
* Operator reports the customer's Autumn 'credits' feature shows balance 248 (sidebar) and 9185 remaining (billing = included_usage - usage). Trying to import 1100 leads returns "Requested 1100 leads exceeds remaining credits".
* apps/web/lib/billing/providers/autumn/client.ts:281 — getEffectiveAutumnGenericCreditsBalance = getBalanceAutumn(balance) + internal billing_account.credit_balance = 248 + (-8937) = -8689. It ignores the recurring grant (included_usage - usage = 9185).
* client.ts:442 canSpend('credits') returns (balance >= quantity) → -8689 >= 1100 → false, so the lead import is denied.
* apps/web/lib/outreach/db/usage.ts canScrapeLeads returns "Requested N leads exceeds remaining credits" on that false.
* Client-side apps/web/hooks/billing/use-billing-credits.ts + lib/billing/display/credit-info.ts compute remaining = included_usage - usage = 9185 and ignore the internal ledger, so the UI shows "enough credits" while the server denies.

BLAST RADIUS:

* Re-counted 2026-09-14T00:12 across all organizations: 428 organizations with confirmed misrouted v0 charges. credit_transaction rows with reference_type 'v0_usage' and 'website_agent_run' total 7,496 rows and about -671,007 credits, settled 2026-03-24 to 2026-09-13T21:41 and still settling (grown from 7,474 rows / -669,740 credits on 2026-09-13T20:03). Count query: SELECT reference_type, count(*), count(DISTINCT organization_id), sum(amount) FROM credit_transaction WHERE reference_type IN ('v0_usage','website_agent_run') GROUP BY reference_type. The v0 usage settlement job is global (V0_USAGE_SETTLEMENT_SCOPE = 'global' in apps/web/lib/billing/v0-usage-settlement.ts) and charges every website-builder user's 'credits' wallet with overdraft allowed, so any other Autumn customer who uses the Name 25 and then runs campaigns is exposed; confirmed charged and exposed-but-unconfirmed are separate and the exposed set is not counted above. The user figure is a bound: metered settlement rows carry no user id. Second independent report on this cause, from a different workspace, is ENG-13628 (2026-09-09).

POTENTIAL FIX:

* Charge v0/website-generation metered usage to a dedicated wallet instead of the shared lead-credit 'credits' wallet, or exclude the metered-overdraft ledger from the lead-credit canSpend path.
* Include the recurring grant (included_usage - usage) in the effective balance used by canSpend('credits').
* Make sidebar/billing surfaces reflect the effective balance (or surface the negative overdraft) so customers are not shown positive credits while the spend is denied.

WHATS NEEDED TO RESOLVE:

* Confirm the intended wallet design after ENG-10788/10798 (unified credits wallet) and whether website metered usage should gate lead credits.
* For this customer: credit the account or move the -8937 v0 usage out of the lead-credit wallet to unblock the 1100-lead import.

CONFIDENCE: High — the negative internal ledger is verified in production and alone explains the block. Autumn feature values (248 / 9185) were not independently readable this run (Autumn lookup returned no customer); those two numbers come from the operator's screenshots.

TRIAGE SCOPE: No branch, commit, PR, deployment, migration, patch, or code/docs/config change was created in this session.

---

INTERCOM: <url:app.intercom.com>
SLACK THREAD: not captured
ORGANIZATION: <uuid>
Filed by Support from a CS investigation.
